definitions.explanation: The quality of being accurate, exact, or free from error. The nominalized form of the na-adjective 正確, used when referring to accuracy as an abstract quality or measurable attribute.

examples.japanese: {正確|せいかく}さが{求|もと}められる。
この{時計|とけい}は{正確|せいかく}さに{定評|ていひょう}がある。
examples.english: This watch has a strong reputation for accuracy.

examples.japanese: {翻訳|ほんやく}では{正確|せいかく}さと{自然|しぜん}さのバランスが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: In translation, balancing accuracy and naturalness is difficult.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix さ to the na-adjective {正確|せいかく} (accurate, precise), turning it into a noun that refers to the quality or degree of accuracy itself.

USAGE:
Used when discussing accuracy as a measurable quality or standard — in contexts like manufacturing, translation, scientific measurement, sports, and timekeeping. While {正確|せいかく} (na-adjective) describes something as accurate, {正確|せいかく}さ (noun) refers to the concept of accuracy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正確|せいかく}さを{求|もと}める — to demand accuracy
- {正確|せいかく}さに{欠|か}ける — to lack accuracy
- {正確|せいかく}さを{重視|じゅうし}する — to value accuracy
- {高|たか}い{正確|せいかく}さ — high accuracy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {精度|せいど} — precision, degree of accuracy; more technical, used in engineering and science
- {正確|せいかく} — accurate (na-adjective); the base adjective form
- {的確|てきかく}さ — aptness, being on-target; emphasizes hitting the right point rather than exactness
